fallback_policy.model_fallback_only_on: upstream provider_error with HTTP 5xx or HTTP-200 embedded upstream error such as code=502 and no choices
fallback_policy.rate_limit_behavior: HTTP 429 or Retry-After/X-RateLimit-* account-limit signal retries the same model after the documented delay; no model fallback request
fallback_policy.other_failures: Timeout, network, auth, invalid request, malformed response, and finish_reason=length do not switch models

governor.scope: process-global across primary, fallback, and retry POSTs

fallback_policy.daily_ledger: Every dispatched generation POST counts regardless of outcome.

request_budget.pace: strictly under 20 RPM including primary, fallback, and retry requests
